method: Explicit editorial choices for every release series and standalone episode in the public-feed snapshot. Read the publisher summaries and existing reviewed coverage, then choose the start of the central conflict or phase, a defining moment of public influence or a focal event/work. Early-life arcs stay in their own period. Broad continuous subjects may use an explicitly explained representative milestone; no arithmetic midpoint is used. Mythic, unrelated cross-era and broad place collections without a defensible single focal year remain off the timeline. The year is a browsing position, not the full duration.
